content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working with [product_name] and [product_name] to monitor temperature in a building and manage two fans. I want to use SCADA to display the temperature data. I understand I need to set up some options on the [product_name] side, but I'm not sure which ones. Any advice or examples would be appreciated.
Which SCADA platform are you referring to? WinCC V7.x? Or WinCC V1x.x?
Check out the [company_name] website for examples. Application resources are available for [product_name].

I looked into the examples, but there are some settings related to communication that seem unclear to me. That's where I'm having trouble—I don't think I have proper communication set up. For instance, I configured the connection in my [product_name] project, but I'm unsure about the corresponding settings on the [product_name] side.
Review the [product_name] application examples for HMI communication, starting from [product_name] version [version_no] (within TIA Portal). You'll find all relevant details there.

I tried following one example, but I don't think the communication between my PC and [product_name] is working. The sample demonstrates communication between [product_name] and an operator panel, while mine involves PC-station (runtime advanced) and [product_name]. Are there differences? Also, in [product_name] setup, should I select 'Add client' or 'Server' connection?

It's essentially the same process—your computer will act as the HMI. You need to set up a server connection in [product_name] software and, in TIA Portal, you should specify [product_name] as the communication driver if it's available from [version_no] (previously used with S7-200).
